name: contacts-high-school-multiplex
description: Multiplex version of the Marseilles high-school contact dataset, rebuilt from the existing contacts-high-school catalog export. Nodes represent students, hyperedges represent clique-promoted face-to-face contact groups, and layers correspond to the five observed school days.

hypergraph_metadata.name: (STRING) Dataset name (e.g., contacts-high-school-multiplex).
hypergraph_metadata.weighted: (BOOL) Whether the hypergraph is weighted (e.g., false).
hypergraph_metadata.layer_type: (STRING) Semantic type of multiplex layers (e.g., school_day).

nodes_metadata.has_facebook: (BOOL) Whether the student has a Facebook account (e.g., true).
nodes_metadata.facebook_friends: (LIST[INT]) List of student IDs who are Facebook friends (e.g., [34, 151, 156]).
nodes_metadata.has_compiled_questionnaire: (BOOL) Whether the student completed the friendship questionnaire (e.g., false).
nodes_metadata.questionnaire_friends: (LIST[INT]) List of student IDs reported as friends in the questionnaire (e.g., [205, 272, 494]).

edges_metadata.layer: (STRING) School-day layer assigned from the contact timeline (e.g., Mon).
